text:
sara_cs: Glenwood (acct: GLNW) ping — they want a custom multimodal invoice extractor that handles PDFs with embedded images. Renewal window opens in ~6 weeks, flagged as 'at-risk' if onboarding stalls.

evan_se: got it. Do we have a footprint for image + OCR preproc? they'd prefer hosted but will consider Dedicated for latency.

jess_ml: we can adapt the 7b multimodal adapter. Main safety ask: redact PII and not retain raw images. They want KMS + audit logs.

olivia_enable: @sara_cs I can run an enablement session next Tue. Need a sample dataset and a short evaluation spec from Glenwood (precision on entity types, recall targets).

sara_cs: sending sample data via secure link shortly. Glenwood wants recall >= 0.92 on invoice numbers and masking of credit card numbers. Also strict delete-on-ingest policy.

mike_ops: note: delete-on-ingest for images requires dedicated s3 lifecycle + no intermediate caches. For Hosted we'll need an exception flow; Dedicated/private preferred.

evan_se: re: evals — propose these buckets: 1) numeric ids (invoice#, totals), 2) vendor names, 3) PHI-like fields (for redaction test). Jess, can you draft an eval harness? put it in /evals/glenwood once ready.

jess_ml: will do. Quick sample prompt for the extractor:
```
Extract invoice_number, vendor_name, line_items[]. For each line_item, return {description, qty, unit_price, total}.
Mask credit_card numbers with <REDACTED>.
```

olivia_enable: also capture enablement feedback form after the first pilot run — 5 q's on accuracy, false positives, speed, integration friction, docs quality.

sara_cs: flagged renewal_risk: HIGH if no pilot by 3/31. Can we get a pilot slot in preprod next week?

mike_ops: I have a slot for a preprod dedicated node Wed or Thu. If they want hosted pilot we can run smaller tests but retention constraints may block.

evan_se: next steps: @jess_ml draft eval harness + canary config; @mike_ops reserve Wed preprod; @olivia_enable schedule enablement and feedback form; @sara_cs confirm sample data upload and PO/contract redlines.

deploy-bot: Release note: reserved preprod node for GLNW on 2025-08-20 09:00 UTC (temp id: preprod-GLNW-03). :white_check_mark:

sara_cs: thanks all — I'll push the sample and summary to the customer folder and update the renewal flag after pilot scheduling.

olivia_enable: ping me once sample is in, I'll prep the session deck and the feedback form link.

jess_ml: will aim to have harness + initial eval results within 48h of sample receipt.

mike_ops: I'll email infra-approvals for the KMS/HSM request now.
